about_the_game:
Detective Worden is a narrative-driven word puzzle game set in a noir world, inspired by Wordle and classic detective fiction. Each word brings you one step closer to the truth.

A mysterious informant sends you cryptic clues in the form of single words. Through deduction, pattern recognition, and a touch of intuition, you'll sift through layers of language to piece together the full picture.

Whether you're pursuing the truth in Story Mode, practicing freely in Free Mode, or testing your skills against others in the Daily Challenge, the game rewards careful thought and calm reasoning.

Features

  • A unique blend of word puzzles and detective storytelling

  • Story Mode: investigate a single case as each clue draws you deeper into the truth

  • Free Mode: practice freely with customizable word length, difficulty, attempt limit, and time constraints

  • Daily Challenge: take on a new puzzle every day and compete with players around the world in logic and speed

  • Stats & History Tracking: review your past answers, performance, and overall progress

  • Retro typewriter-style interface with immersive sound design and nostalgic visuals
